$comment: Reversible raw→canonical category mapping. Stored bookmark data is NEVER rewritten; this map is applied at classification/eval time. version + changes[] make every collapse decision auditable and revertible. This version is explicitly experimental: head/canonical separability is a hypothesis to be tested, not a product decision.

changes.note: Initial experiment mapping. Head classes observed with >=10 samples pass through; all few-shot/novel slugs collapse to `other` for evaluation. Revisit if eval shows usefulness loss. Renamed from v1-head-plus-other to mark experimental status; map content unchanged.
